name: M6.Character.constant_transform
statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (q : M6.Character.Vector m), (q = 0 → M6.Character.localTransform (fun _ _ => (1 : Polynomial ℤ)) q = Polynomial.C ((2 : ℤ)^m)) ∧ (q ≠ 0 → M6.Character.localTransform (fun _ _ => (1 : Polynomial ℤ)) q = 0)
guidance: Expand the binary coordinate sum. When q i=0 its factor is2; when q i=1 it is0. For q≠0 choose a nonzero coordinate to make the product0. Use literal q i=0∨q i=1 before simp to avoid fin_cases leaving Fin constructors. Return tactics only without leading by.
